messages:
Maya (CS): @here heads-up — ZenithHealth onboarding flagged a mismatch between contracted SLA and our reported SLOs. They expect 99.95% uptime and p95 latency <200ms for inference route 'embed-prod', but our last-30d shows ~99.89% uptime and p95 ~230ms. Need a clean report + credit calc before their renewal review on 2024-12-12. :wave:

Jordan (AE): Copy. Renewal meeting is on the calendar. Do we have a recommended credit formula we can show them?

Liam (SRE): Quick context: our uptime calc is rolling 30d, downtime = >5xx spikes >5min. Contractual 99.95% ~= 21.6 minutes allowed per 30d. Observed deficit is ~6.5 minutes over that window. Rough prorated credit = (deficit_minutes / allowed_minutes) * monthly_charge. I'll validate with incident timelines.

Priya (PM): Recommend a one-pager that shows: current metrics, recent incidents with RCA tags, mitigation plan (autoscale, cache warmers, kernel tuning), and the credit calc. Also add a weekly exported SLO snapshot we can attach to customer reporting.

Maya (CS): Can eng produce a CSV export we can ship that includes uptime, p95, incident ids, and the credit calc? Example command for the ops runbook: `redwood metrics export --customer zenith --window 30d --metrics uptime,p95,incidents --format csv`

Liam (SRE): I can add a monitoring export job under Monitoring -> Exports. Will include incident_id, start,end,rca_tag,observed_downtime,observed_p95. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Credit calc snippet I'll include in the job output: `credit_minutes = max(0, observed_downtime - allowed_downtime)` then `credit_amount = (credit_minutes / allowed_downtime) * monthly_fee`

Jordan (AE): Please loop in Finance on the presentation. @Nora (Finance) can you confirm whether we present the remediation as an invoice credit (next bill) or a one-time refund? Also need confirmation on rounding and minimum credit thresholds.

Nora (Finance): Prefer invoice credit on next cycle. Need the monthly fee figure and the exact credit_amount calculation. I can sign off once I see the numbers and the CSV output. ETA EOD for arithmetic check.

Priya (PM): Also want to capture onboarding feedback in the packet — add a short survey link in the report: key Qs: 'Is current latency acceptable for your users?' (yes/no) + free text for examples. That feedback will feed into Optimize recommendations.

Maya (CS): Action list: 1) Liam: export job + credit calc included (ETA EOD tomorrow) 2) Priya: one-pager + feedback form to embed in report (ETA 48h) 3) Nora: confirm credit modality and rounding rules (ETA EOD) 4) Maya: assemble draft report and schedule customer follow-up once artifacts are in.

Liam (SRE): Noted. I'll post the export link here when ready. :white_check_mark:

Priya (PM): I'll drop the one-pager draft in this thread in 48h. :eyes:

Maya (CS): Thanks team — goal is transparent reporting + clear credit calc before their renewal discussion so we reduce churn risk. I'll update thread as items land. :thumbsup:
